item.title: Ascott signs record 19,000 units across 102 properties in 2025
item.description: Ascott secured a record 19,000 units across 102 properties in 2025, representing 27 per cent year-on-year growth in new signings. item.title: Komodo visitor cap sparks concern among operators
item.description: Indonesia’s Ministry of Forestry has capped daily visitor numbers to Komodo National Park at 1,000, citing the need to protect its terrestrial and aquatic ecosystems.
